desc: Implement per-digit residue DP (d=1..9), updating counts via (10r+c) mod d, adding the length-1 substring, and adding nc[0] to the answer when the current char equals d.
Verify against the three provided examples by hand-reasoning: "12936"→11 (d1:1, d2:2, d9:1, d3:3, d6:4), "5701283"→18, "1010101010"→25.
Confirm substrings ending in digit 0 never contribute (d ranges 1..9) and leading zeros are absorbed by the x→10x+c recurrence.
Confirm runtime O(45n) ≈ 4.5e6 ops for n=1e5 and O(1) extra space per d.
